overview: Retyping client names and prices into a Word file is slow and invites errors. We turn your quotes, contracts, certificates or letters into templates that fill themselves from a form, CRM deal or sheet row, and produce a finished PDF saved to a folder and sent to the client. Signing can be added through an e-signature tool you already use, and wording stays exactly as you approved it.

faq: Can you use my existing Word or Google Docs files?
Yes. Send us your current quote or contract and we turn it into a template with placeholders, keeping your wording and layout as close as possible.
Which e-signature tools can you connect?
DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, PandaDoc and Adobe Sign, depending on your plan. You hold the account, and we do not change the legal text or signing rules.
Is a generated contract legally valid?
We build the mechanism, not the wording. Whether a contract is valid for you depends on its content and your location, so have a lawyer approve your template.
Where does the data in the document come from?
From a form, a CRM deal, a spreadsheet or your store, whichever you choose. We map each placeholder to a field and test that every value lands in the right place.
